intro: Cinq Mirror combines clean geometry with understated sophistication. With its warm neutral palette and slender steel frame, it brings lightness, functionality, and modern elegance to entryway spaces.

features.title: Streamlined form and neutral palette for refined spaces
features.text: The Cinq 300 entryway mirror features a clean, minimalist profile that enhances contemporary interiors without overwhelming the space. Furthermore, its subtle finish blends effortlessly with varied decor themes, allowing the mirror to integrate seamlessly into both muted and bold interior settings.

features.title: Elegant tubular steel frame for lasting support
features.text: The slender tubular steel structure introduces a subtle industrial character while providing dependable strength and stability for everyday use.

features.title: Full-height mirror for everyday convenience
features.text: The elongated mirror design offers a full-length reflection, making daily dressing and grooming routines more comfortable and convenient.

features.title: Elevated structure for airy visual appeal
features.text: Raised from the ground, the mirror creates a lighter visual footprint while allowing easier floor cleaning and improved openness within the space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
